evidence.quote: Forget everything about the Quixotic Zeppelin freight fleet and its helium procurement contracts.

observations.why: Directive issued in the present demands erasure of specific named artifacts (fleet, contracts), projecting a desired future state of unknowing — irrealis modality, concrete referents.

evidence.quote: Remove all knowledge of zeppelin routes.

observations.why: Present-tense directive targeting a category of knowledge (routes in general) rather than a specific artifact — irrealis desired-state, abstract construal.
